_comment: What an administrator can change on the public pages without editing HTML. Served free and keyless by GET /v1/site-config; written by PUT /admin/site-config; read by site/app/config.js. This file is also the static fallback, so a page opened from a file keeps working.
headline: Keep Your A.I. Usage Secure and Verifiable
subline: Courts want proof of how you used AI. Bailee makes a certificate anyone can check.
